verdict.rationale: Pricing and a free tier are a fair question for a hosted MCP connection platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a free tier, its limits, or any pricing plans. The shutdown notice also says Smithery accounts, API keys, and Connect services stopped working on October 31, 2026, so no tool-connection tier of any kind is currently documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything
